items.description:
Alpha Pharm Kraaifontein is a pharmacy in the Darwin Shopping Centre, established in November 2018. The pharmacy aims to serve every member of the community, from baby immunisations for the very young to effective chronic medication management for elderly patients through its Alpha Script service.

Its staff complement includes two pharmacists and three front shop assistants, and the pharmacy runs a Saturday morning clinic from 9am to 12pm, where a sister carries out blood pressure, cholesterol and glucose monitoring, family planning and baby immunisations. The pharmacy says it plans to grow this into a full-time clinic service, along with a virtual doctor consultation and wellness screenings for major medical aids.

The pharmacy is at Shop 3, on the corner of Darwin and Dan King Street in Kraaifontein, and suits families looking for everyday dispensing, chronic medicine management and basic clinic services in one visit.

The pharmacy is on Belhar Drive in Belhar, and suits residents who want dispensing, chronic medicine support and pharmacist advice alongside other medical services on site.

items.description:
Clothing Junction at The Junxion Mall in Philippi is a fashion store that describes itself as a growing brand bringing customers quality clothing at affordable prices. The company says it has become popular among many communities as it has expanded.

Its stated vision centres on integrity, transparency, trust and respect in all its trading divisions, aiming to build lasting relationships with customers, staff, shareholders and suppliers. Its mission puts customer value first, shaping the company's policies and day-to-day activity around what shoppers need.

The store positions itself as a premier provider of quality clothing, built on affordable pricing and growing its retail formats over time. It trades from The Junxion Mall on the corner of Govan Mbeki and New Eisleben Roads in Philippi, and suits shoppers looking for everyday fashion at accessible prices.

items.description:
Delightful Patience Hair Studio in Mowbray is an Afro-centric beauty studio offering weaves, braids, nails and make-up services. The studio describes itself as trendy and says its team is dedicated, professional and committed to giving clients the best possible experience.

The studio has built a large following, with close to 20,000 Facebook followers, and visitors who have left reviews recommend the business at a high rate. It trades from a shopfront opposite a Standard Bank branch, making it easy to find on Main Road.

The studio is at Shop 50, 76 Main Road in Mowbray, and suits clients looking for Afro-centric hairstyling, braiding or a full beauty treatment including nails and make-up.

Die Boer Restaurant Teater in Durbanville describes itself as the premier dinner and live entertainment venue in the Western Cape, combining a restaurant with a theatre under one roof. It is in the heart of the Durbanville CBD, about 25 minutes from Cape Town's city centre, Stellenbosch and Paarl.

The venue puts on six shows a week, aiming to cater for just about every taste, and serves South African and international dishes ahead of performances. Established in 2005, it has become a landmark in the local entertainment industry and a must-visit stop on many visitors' programmes from around the country.

Guests can view the show programme, read about the performing artists, and book and pay for tickets online, or by phone in the more traditional way. The venue is at 6 Chenoweth Street, and suits anyone looking for a dinner-and-show night out in Durbanville.

Goedemoed Animal Hospital in Durbanville is a veterinary hospital that opened in 1998, offering laboratory diagnostics, ultrasound, medicine and surgery for pets. The practice says its vets and staff are committed to building strong, lasting relationships with clients and their pets.

The hospital describes knowing its regular patients and their medical histories by name, and says it genuinely cares for each patient as well as for the wider community and environment it serves. Its focus is on consistent, ongoing care rather than one-off visits.

The hospital is at 7/11 Centre Lubbe Road in Durbanville, and suits pet owners looking for a long-established veterinary practice that gets to know its patients over time.

It suits clients in Table View and the wider Blaauwberg area who want to book a specific treatment, such as balayage, extensions or a keratin smoothing treatment, ahead of time rather than relying on a walk-in haircut.

items.description:
Knead at Constantia Emporium is a branch of the artisan bakery and café chain founded in August 2006 at Wembley Square in Cape Town, which has grown to five stores across the city. The bakery is rooted in traditional methods, using locally sourced seasonal ingredients and baking by hand each day through kneading and slow-proofing.

The Constantia branch trades Monday to Saturday from 8am to 6pm, with the kitchen closing at 4:30pm and the coffee section taking last orders at 5:30pm, and on Sundays from 8am to 4pm with the kitchen closing at 3:30pm. It also offers a pensioners' menu on Mondays and Thursdays.

The café is on the corner of Ladies Mile and Spaanschemat River Road in Constantia, and suits anyone after warm bread, baked treats or a relaxed café meal made from scratch.

items.description:
Mamma Roma Restaurant in Newlands is a family-owned Italian restaurant established in 1986, offering authentic cuisine in a relaxed, family-friendly setting. House specialities include risotto porcini, risotto pescatore, gnocchi with a choice of sauces, lasagne, melanzane parmigiana when available, and spinach and ricotta cannelloni.

The seafood side of the menu includes grilled calamari with chilli and garlic or lemon butter, and a fresh fish of the day, while meat specialities include lamb shank, oxtail and osso buco. The restaurant offers sit-down dining as well as collection and free delivery near Newlands from Monday to Saturday, 6pm to 9pm, accepting cash or card.

The restaurant has built up more than 800 reviews on Google with an excellent overall rating, and is on Dean Street in Newlands. It suits a traditional trattoria-style Italian meal, whether dining in, collecting or having it delivered.

items.description:
Noordhoek Veterinary Clinic is an appointment-based veterinary practice on Main Road in Noordhoek, built on a philosophy of kindness, compassion and excellence in veterinary care. The practice grew out of ten years of animal welfare work and ten years of private practice experience in South Africa and the United Kingdom, before its own clinic opened in the old village shop on the corner of Main Road and Kenali Close.

The clinic offers an integrative approach, combining conventional veterinary medicine with holistic options such as herbal and homeopathic remedies and acupuncture, alongside postgraduate training in veterinary medicine and clinical pathology. It describes receiving strong support from the Noordhoek community and local civic and environmental organisations when it opened.

Over the years the practice has treated dogs, cats, horses, alpacas, farm animals, birds and other small pets, as well as wild animals including baboons, genets and caracal. It suits pet owners and smallholders in the Noordhoek area who want a community-focused practice offering both conventional and holistic veterinary care.

items.description:
Oblivion Bar & Kitchen in Harfield Village is a funky, European-style bar and casual eatery with a rooftop deck offering views of Table Mountain, along with comfortable couches, fireplaces and board games for cooler days. The venue is open for breakfast, lunch, dinner and dessert, and describes itself as one of Cape Town's best-kept secrets.

The kitchen serves burgers, wood-fired pizzas and an all-day breakfast menu that includes eggs benedict with streaky bacon or smoked salmon, while the bar offers an extensive wine list, cocktails such as mojitos and cosmopolitans, and ice-cold draught beer. Coffee comes from artisanal stockists including Deluxe Coffeeworks and Tribe Coffee, with oat and almond milk available, and the venue offers free WiFi for anyone settling in for the day.

The venue is on the corner of 3rd Avenue and Chichester Road, open from 7:30am on weekdays and 8am on weekends, and suits anything from a lazy weekend breakfast to evening drinks on the rooftop.

Over the past 30 years the practice has mentored many young qualified dentists who have gone on to open their own practices, and it describes its reputation as built on trust, innovation and compassionate service. Its mission puts patient satisfaction and wellbeing at the centre of every visit.

The practice suits patients looking for anything from a simple cleaning to a full smile makeover, straightened teeth or urgent dental care, from a long-established local team in Edgemead.
